patch_description: This crossover restores the strongest low-parameter structure from the best-performing parent: globally shared RY/RZ basis preparation, complete-graph CZ entanglement aligned with all 28 pairwise feature channels, two complementary CRZ bridges sharing one parameter, and shared post-entanglement RY mixing. It removes the current program’s tied global RX layer, which increased gate count and reduced validation accuracy. The result retains four parameters per block and 26 total parameters while targeting the prior 0.96 validation accuracy, zero generalization gap, and lower loss.
